spans.s:
Koladdhaja
an. TIkA one of the Palī texts an. its C. mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan dated 1442 A. D.
See J. Myth. Soc. XXII. p. 412; Bode, Pāli Lit. Burma, p. 108.

Kolanṛpotpatti
paur. in 11 chs. on Kolattiri kings of Kerala; assigned to Bhaviṣyatpurāṇa (not found in ptd. edn. of purāṇa); Umāmaheśvarasaṁvāda. [Page095-b]

Kolāupamanasutta
Q. by Nāgārjuna, in his Daśabhūmivibhāṣāśāstra; title restored by R. Kimura.
See IHQ. III. p. 417.

Kolāpurakṣetramāhātmya
in 3 chs. on Kollūr near Mangalore, from Skandapurāṇa.
Pt.. with C. Ucitabodhinī of Devīdāsa. Udipi, 1917. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 810 an. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1360.
See next.

Kolāpurakṣetramāhātmya
or Mūkāmbikāpurāṇa. from Sahyādrikhaṇḍa of Skandapurāṇa in 22 adhys.
Pt.. Pattambi, 1899. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 505.

Kolāpuramāhātmya
belonging to Bhairavapurāṇa.
--Śrī Māraṇakaṭṭe Brahmacaritra from. in 36 verses; on the demon Mūka slain by Devī an. reborn a. Māraṇakaṭṭe Brahma, a spirit in her service.
Pt.. with Kannada transl. Kolloor: Udipi, 1917. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 498. 499.

Kolāhala
name of Puṇḍarīkācārya's C. on the kāvya Tripuravijaya of Mahendrācārya.
See V. Raghavan, p.. 10-11, Intro. to his edn. of Amaramaṇḍana of Kṛṣṇasūri, DCRI. Poona, 1949.

Koleśvaramāhātmya
paur. by Nārāyaṇan Nambūtiri of Śīvolli (1868-1905 A. D.).
See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 264.
